prompt:
Create a transparent pixel-art animation sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, square canvas, 16 complete robots. Reference is character identity and palette only. Four hover animation frames per direction.
CRITICAL: row 1 SOUTH is a perfectly straight-on frontal elevation, zero yaw, ZERO three-quarter perspective. Central faceplate is symmetrical with identical left/right widths, two square mint eyes equally distant from center, both shoulders and arms equally visible and same size, antenna precisely centered. NO visible side plane on either side of the face. Robot looks directly toward viewer / due south.
Row 2 WEST: pure left profile, face edge on left, cream side and round shoulder.
Row 3 NORTH: straight symmetrical rear view, no eyes, cream back and small vent.
Row 4 EAST: pure right profile, face edge on right, cream side and round shoulder.
Within EVERY row, columns are four hovering frames: body vertical offset 0, -6, -12, -6 pixels relative to cell; thruster short, medium, long, medium. Keep identical size, position horizontally, anatomy and orientation across all four frames in a row. Subtle deliberate animation, no other pose changes. Robot body plus arms uses only central 60% of cell width; all content stays within central 80% of cell height with at least 10% transparent padding on every edge. True transparent background, no grid lines, no labels.
Cream rounded square shell, deep teal faceplate, mint square eyes, small brass antenna centered on top, teal arms lowered at sides, single mint hover thruster below, no legs, no objects. Warm cozy chunky pixel art, hard square pixels, 3-tone shading, dark #263f3c outlines, cream #f0e4bb, teal #35665b, mint #8fc7a3. Light from top left but geometry of front/back remains symmetric. No text, crops, tools, ground, gradients or blurred outlines. Do NOT copy the reference's angled frontal view; replace frontal geometry with exact centered straight-on view.
